title: Late fee with a cap
description: Feature request for the library's late fee function. Today it charges a fee per day of lateness after a grace period and ignores its third parameter, an optional cap. Make the cap work. The complete rule is: the first 3 days late are free; every further day costs the daily amount, so the plain fee is (days late minus 3) times the daily amount, and 0 when the loan is at most 3 days late or not late at all (days late of 0 or below). With no cap the plain fee is charged. With a cap of c the fee is the plain fee but never more than c, and a cap below 0 counts as 0. The daily amount is never negative.
notes: Feature: apply the clamped cap. Start already has the grace period and the non-negative floor, and ignores cap. A cap of some(0) must give 0, some(-20) too (counts as 0). Multiplication only, no division.
